GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report splits could not be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, trademo.com returned HTTP 403, and the web_search backend was unavailable ('searx: Connection refused') for the query '"Central Tyres" Mumbai GST turnover GeM tender tyre supply'. Domestic turnover/contract data is therefore null, not zero.
note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs bill-of-lading records, not by website claims: two outbound consignments of truck/bus radial tyres to Onne, Nigeria (BOL 2879655, 2025-06-20, ex Nhava Sheva; BOL 3169675, 2024-08-13, ex Tuticorin ICD). Note the declared HS 401110 (new pneumatic tyres for motor cars) does not match the actual recorded HS 40112010 (new pneumatic tyres for buses/lorries) on both export rows — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground; the factual code is 40112010 and the verdict should be accepted_hs_corrected. The company also imports (Carpenter Belgium BV T-25/TIREFILL chemicals HS 39095000, BOL 7221780, 2026-01-31; Polycoat Products POLY-FIL HS 39095000, BOL 2880538, 2024-04-04), i.e. it behaves as a trader/distributor rather than a pure manufacturer — role likely trader or manufacturer_trader, to be confirmed separately. Domestic (India) supply activity is unverified: no GST turnover band, tender or contract record was publicly retrievable within the tool budget, so domestic_status is 'unknown' and revenue/domestic figures are null — not invented. Caveat on data quality: the ImportKey 'Buyers'/'Suppliers' side panels mix unrelated companies (Kalmar, Polycoat, JMS Mining etc.), so only the 5 dated shipment rows in the main table were used as evidence.
